sentences.text: Atomic Blonde is a 2017 American action spy thriller film directed by David Leitch and written by Kurt Johnstad .	David Leitch	David Leitch (director)	action	action film	spy	Spy film	thriller film	thriller film

It is based on Antony Johnston and Sam Hart 's 2012 graphic novel The Coldest City , which revolves around a spy who has to find a list of double agents who are being smuggled into the West .	Antony Johnston	Antony Johnston	spy	Spy film

The film stars Charlize Theron , James McAvoy , John Goodman , Til Schweiger , Eddie Marsan , Sofia Boutella , and Toby Jones .	Charlize Theron	Charlize Theron	James McAvoy	James McAvoy	John Goodman	John Goodman	Til Schweiger	Til Schweiger	Eddie Marsan	Eddie Marsan	Sofia Boutella	Sofia Boutella	Toby Jones	Toby Jones
This will be Leitch 's first solo credit as director , after co-directing John Wick with Chad Stahelski .	John Wick	John Wick	Chad Stahelski	Chad Stahelski
The film had its world premiere at South by Southwest on March 12 , 2017 .	South by Southwest	South by Southwest
It will be released theatrically on July 28 , 2017 , by Focus Features .	Focus Features	Focus Features
